crossRefs.note: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

translations.web: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.
translations.bsb: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.
translations.kjv: And the men did so; and took two milch kine, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home:
